title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Funding Fee Refund Relief Following an Offset on the Veteran's VA Debts
content:
When VA has recently collected an offset on a veteran's VA debts, the part of a VA Home Loan Guaranty funding fee refund that may be applied against a home loan guaranty debt is limited once more. The date that counts is the date of the latest offset collected on any of the veteran's VA debts, as the debt histories in the veteran's Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery records show it, measured in months before today.

## Offset relief

| Latest offset collected on the veteran's VA debts | Offset relief |
|---|---|
| Less than 6 months before today | 50 percent |
| At least 6 months but less than 24 months before today | 75 percent |
| Otherwise (24 months or more before today, or no offset ever collected) | Not limited (100 percent) |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical offset dates, in months before today)

| Months before today | Offset relief |
|---|---|
| 0 (an offset this month) | 50 |
| 5 | 50 |
| 6 | 75 |
| 23 | 75 |
| 24 | 100 |
| No offset on record | 100 |

## Points of judgement

- Only offset collections count; a direct payment or a credit on a debt is not an offset.
- The offset may have been collected on any of the veteran's VA debts, not only on the home loan guaranty debt.
- The recent-offset number is 6 months and the earlier-offset number is 24 months; each threshold belongs to the later row.
